lines.t: He stays a teacher, steady in the silence
Repeating truth we already heard
Calling it back when our vision bursts
Before we forget what we were reaching for
Echoes of lessons we pushed aside
Still breaking through our pride
He calls before we drift too far
Before we lose who we are
Voicing the distance steady and true
Pulling us back into view
It was before the fall begins
Before we're buried in our sins
Love doesn't wait for the scars
He comes before we drift too far
He walks the hills like a faithful shepherd
Calling our names in the wind
Before we wonder where shadows begin
Before we're lost in the dark again
He sees the turn before it's made
Before we fall astray
He calls before we drift too far
Before we lose who we are
Voice in the distance, steady and true
Pulling us back into view
Here once before the fall begins
Before we're buried in our sins
Love doesn't wait for the scars
He calls before we drift too far
A father who won't let silence remain
He reveals the hidden stains
While there's still time to change direction
Before the weight becomes our chain
He shows the fault while we can still stand
Before it slips out of our hands
Crooked roads don't hold us yet
Mercy speaks so we won't forget
He calls before we drift too far
Before we lose who we are
Voicing the distance steady and true
Pulling us back into view
He warns before the fall begins
Before we're buried in our sins
Love doesn't wait for the scars
He calls before we drift too far
Still the teacher, still the guide
Still the voice we cannot run inside
Calling us back before we fall apart
Before we drift too far
